title: Carlos Yulo emerges triumphant in vault final, clinches PH's second Asiad gold
summary: Carlos Yulo clinched Philippines' second gold medal at the 20th Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026 after emerging triumphant in the vault final on Friday at the Nagoya General Gymnasium.
